features.title: Wildcard catastrophic events
features.user_visible_behavior: Wildcard events fire stochastically per step. Event file is written to board for agents to read. Includes asteroid, gamma ray, volcano, snowball, alien, deus ex machina.
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_models.py::test_wildcards_loaded -v
uv run pytest tests/test_models.py::test_wildcard_board_write -v
uv run pytest tests/test_models.py::test_roll_wildcard -v
features.notes: state_impact is advisory only — not auto-applied to state. Fixed by fix-002.

verification: uv run pytest tests/test_models.py::test_load_mediterranean_scenario -v
uv run pytest tests/test_models.py::test_entity_state_merged_into_workspace -v
features.notes: Interaction logic (can_interact_with, InteractionConfig) declared in model but NOT implemented in loop. Fixed by feat-002.

features.title: Fix _fallback_resolution to use deep merge
features.user_visible_behavior: When no judge is available, fallback resolution deep-merges proposals instead of overwriting.
verification: Add test: two proposals with overlapping nested keys both survive in fallback resolution.
Existing 14 tests still pass.
features.notes: Currently uses dict.update() which silently drops earlier proposals' nested keys. 5 min fix.

features.title: Auto-apply wildcard state_impact to board state
features.user_visible_behavior: When a wildcard fires, its state_impact is deep-merged into state.json before agents run. Agents still see the wildcard file for context, but the impact is guaranteed applied.
verification: Add test: wildcard with state_impact modifies state.json when applied.
Add test: agents still see wildcard file in board/ alongside the state change.
features.notes: Currently state_impact is advisory — agents may ignore it. 10 min fix.

features.title: Agent output retry and validation
features.user_visible_behavior: If an agent writes malformed JSON or fails to write a file, the system retries once. After retry failure, logs a warning and proceeds with None rather than silently dropping.
verification: Add test: malformed JSON file is handled gracefully with warning.
Add test: missing output file triggers one retry.
Add test: retry exhaustion produces explicit log message.
features.notes: Currently parse_proposal/parse_critique/parse_resolution silently return None on any failure.

features.title: Implement entity interaction logic
features.user_visible_behavior: Population entities can see each other's proposals when can_interact_with allows it. InteractionConfig controls when interactions happen (always, every N steps, conditional). Interaction info is injected into agent prompts.
verification: Add test: population agent prompt includes visible neighbor proposals.
Add test: InteractionMode.NEVER prevents cross-entity visibility.
Add test: InteractionMode.SCHEDULED with every_n_steps=3 only shows neighbors on step 0, 3, 6.
Add test: can_interact_with filters which entities are visible.
features.notes: Schema exists (can_interact_with, InteractionConfig, InteractionMode) but zero runtime implementation. Estimated 1-2 hrs.

features.title: Trajectory visualization
features.user_visible_behavior: CLI subcommand 'worldsim visualize' reads completed run data and generates: (1) state field timelines per trajectory, (2) outcome distribution bar chart, (3) wildcard event markers on timeline, (4) population score evolution for entity scenarios.
verification: Run worldsim visualize on a completed run directory.
Verify PNG files are generated for each plot type.
Verify plots render correctly for both counterfactual and population scenarios.
features.notes: User explicitly requested visualization of evolution/changes. Needs matplotlib as optional dependency.

features.title: End-to-end test with Claude CLI
features.user_visible_behavior: A minimal 1-trajectory, 2-step scenario completes a full loop with real Claude CLI subprocess calls. Produces valid trajectory.json with outcome classification.
verification: Run a minimal scenario end-to-end with actual claude -p calls.
Verify trajectory.json exists with valid structure.
Verify state.json was updated across steps.
Verify narrative.md has step entries.
features.notes: Requires claude CLI installed and authenticated. This is the real smoke test for the whole system.

features.title: Fitness tracking for open_ended mode
features.user_visible_behavior: In open_ended mode, a fitness function evaluates each step against a configured metric. Fitness scores are logged per step. Simulation can terminate when fitness plateaus or reaches a threshold.
verification: Add test: FitnessConfig is read and fitness is computed per step.
Add test: open_ended mode terminates on fitness plateau.
Add test: fitness scores are recorded in trajectory output.
features.notes: FitnessConfig model exists but nothing reads it. Needed for open_ended mode to be distinct from counterfactual.

features.title: Mode collapse mitigation
features.user_visible_behavior: Across trajectories, the system varies agent behavior to prevent convergent outcomes: temperature variation, perspective rotation (randomized emphasis in prompts), wildcard diversity enforcement. A convergence detector warns when trajectories are too similar.
verification: Add test: different trajectory IDs produce different prompt variations.
Add test: convergence detector flags when >80% of trajectories have same outcome classification at same step.
features.notes: LLM echo chamber effect (NeurIPS 2024) is a known risk for debate-based systems.

features.title: Checkpoint and resume
features.user_visible_behavior: A simulation can be resumed from any step. If a run is interrupted, restarting from the same output directory picks up where it left off using history/ snapshots.
verification: Add test: interrupted trajectory resumes from last completed step.
Add test: resumed trajectory produces same final structure as uninterrupted.
features.notes: History snapshots (step_NNN_state.json) already exist. Need resume detection in runner.
